arxiv-2205-06324.title: Graph Neural Network Modeling of Grain-scale Anisotropic Elastic Behavior using Simulated and Measured Microscale Data Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2205-06324.creator: Darren C. Pagan 1*, Calvin R. Pash 1, Austin R. Benson 2, Matthew P. Kasemer 3
arxiv-2205-06324.description: Abstract Here we assess the applicability of graph neural networks (GNNs) for predicting the grain-scale elastic response of polycrystalline metallic alloys. Using GNN surrogate models, grain-averaged stresses during uniaxial elastic tension in Low Solvus High Refractory (LSHR) Ni Superalloy and Ti 7wt%Al (Ti-7Al), as example face centered cubic and hexagonal closed packed alloys, are predicted.

arxiv-2206-06723.title: Development of a hybrid method for stock trading based on TOPSIS, EMD and ELM Journal: Applied Soft Computing
arxiv-2206-06723.creator: Elivelto Ebermam, Helder Knidel, Renato A. Krohling
arxiv-2206-06723.description: Abstract Deciding when to buy or sell a stock is not an easy task because the market is hard to predict, being influenced by political and economic factors. Thus, methodologies based on computational intelligence have been applied to this challenging problem.

arxiv-2301-02620.title: Information Flow Tracking Methods for Protecting Cyber-Physical Systems against Hardware Trojans - a Survey -
arxiv-2301-02620.creator: Sofia Maragkou, Axel Jantsch
arxiv-2301-02620.description: Abstract Cyber-physical systems (CPS) provide profitable surfaces for hardware attacks such as hardware Trojans. Hardware Trojans can implement stealthy attacks such as leaking critical information, taking control of devices or harm humans. In this article we review information flow tracking (IFT) methods for protecting CPS against hardware Trojans, and discuss their current limitations.

arxiv-2309-16885.title: Accretion disk wind of Hercules X-1 during the Short High state Facilities: Chandra SPEX ( Kaastra et al. 1996 ) , Veusz
arxiv-2309-16885.creator: P. Kosec, E. Kara, A. C. Fabian, C. Pinto, I. Psaradaki, D. Rogantini, R. Staubert, D. J. Walton
arxiv-2309-16885.description: Abstract Hercules X-1 is a nearly edge-on X-ray binary with a warped, precessing accretion disk, which manifests through a 35-day cycle of alternating High and Low flux states. This disk precession introduces a changing line of sight towards the X-ray source, through an ionized accretion disk wind.

arxiv-2311-01217.description: Abstract . Can temporary subsidies to bundles induce long-run changes in demand due to learning about the quality of one of the constituent goods? This paper provides theoretical support and empirical evidence on this mechanism. Theoretically, we introduce a model where an agent learns about the quality of an innovation through repeated consumption.

arxiv-2402-05870.title: Revisiting Schwarzschild black hole singularity through string theory
arxiv-2402-05870.creator: Houwen Wu, Zihan Yan, Shuxuan Ying
arxiv-2402-05870.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Houwen Wu, Zihan Yan, Shuxuan Ying. In this letter, we derive the singular condition for black holes and demonstrate the potential resolution of the black hole singularity in general relativity using non-perturbative α ′ \alpha^{\prime} corrections of string theory. This work is motivated by the Belinskii, Khalatnikov and Lifshitz (BKL) proposal, which suggests that the structure of the black hole interior in vacuum Einstein’s equations can be transformed into the Kasner universe near the singularity.

arxiv-2504-01536.title: Investigate Substructures of the Inner Halo Using the StarGO Algorithm with APOGEE DR17
arxiv-2504-01536.creator: Zhongcheng Li, Cuihua Du, Haoyang Liu, Dashuang Ye
arxiv-2504-01536.description: Abstract We applied Stars’ Galactic Origin (StarGO) algorithm in 7-D space (i.e. [Fe/H], [Mg/Fe], [Al/Fe], L z , J r , J z , E L_{z},\,J_{r},\,J_{z},\,E ) to analyze stars in the inner halo with APOGEE DR17. We identified some known substructures, including Gaia–Sausage–Enceladus (GSE), Sagittarius Stream (Sgr), LMS-1 (Wukong), Thamnos, Metal-Weak Thick Disk (MWTD) and Aleph.

arxiv-2504-08438.title: Diffusion Models for Robotic Manipulation: A Survey
arxiv-2504-08438.creator: Rosa Wolf, Yitian Shi, Sheng Liu, Rania Rayyes
arxiv-2504-08438.description: Abstract Diffusion generative models have demonstrated remarkable success in visual domains such as image and video generation. They have also recently emerged as a promising approach in robotics, especially in robot manipulations. Diffusion models leverage a probabilistic framework, and they stand out with their ability to model multi-modal distributions and their robustness to high-dimensional input and output spaces.

pmc-11692835.title: EFFECTS OF FRAILTY AND FUNCTIONAL IMPAIRMENT ON THE ASSOCIATIONS OF COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT AND DEMENTIA WITH HEALTHCARE COSTS
pmc-11692835.creator: Howard Fink, Kerry Sheets, Lisa Langsetmo, John Schousboe, Allyson Kats, Kristine Ensrud
pmc-11692835.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Dementia and cognitive impairment (DCI) are associated with higher total healthcare costs (THC). We sought to determine the fraction of incremental THC of DCI accounted for by frailty and/or functional impairment. We utilized a multi-cohort dataset of 8165 community-dwelling, fee-for-service Medicare beneficiaries (53% women, 79% non-Hispanic White, mean age 79 years) who had index exams in 1 of 4 prospective cohort studies linked with Medicare claims. Cohort-based DCI was defined by self-or-proxy report of a dementia diagnosis or abnormal cognitive test results.

pmc-11712573.title: Dementia and Lifestyle Risk Factors in Sub‐Saharan Africa: Exploring Epidemiological Insights
pmc-11712573.creator: Tobi Nifemi Olajide, Isaac Babawale, Ifeoluwa Oluwasegun Oduguwa, Rachel Dada, Evelyn Ogungbemi, Napoleon Tejiri, Adeosun Ololade, Chukwuebuka Stanley Asogwa, Adamma Njoku, Oghenemaro Jerry‐Ogeme, Joshua Alabi, Teslim Adepoju, James Iziren, Deborah Ogundijo, Oluwatimilehin Oladapo, Habib Shobanke, C
pmc-11712573.description: BackgroundThe emergence of dementia as a global health challenge necessitates an exploration of its unique epidemiological patterns and risk factors in Sub‐Saharan Africa (SSA). Amid a growing elderly population, SSA presents an intriguing paradox of lower‐than‐expected dementia prevalence, prompting a comprehensive review of epidemiological nuances, lifestyle risk factors, cultural influences, and protective factors.

pmc-12573762.title: Convergence and Properties of Intrinsic Bond Orbitals in Solids
pmc-12573762.creator: Benjamin Wöckinger, Alexander Rumpf, Tobias Schäfer
pmc-12573762.description: We present a study of the construction and spatial properties of localized Wannier orbitals in large supercells of insulating solids using plane waves as the underlying basis. The Pipek-Mezey (PM) functional in combination with intrinsic atomic orbitals (IAOs) as projectors is employed, resulting in so-called intrinsic bond orbitals (IBOs).

pmc-12610117.title: Advances in MXene Materials: Fabrication, Properties, and Applications
pmc-12610117.creator: Subin Antony Jose, Jordan Price, Jessica Lopez, Erick Perez-Perez, Pradeep L. Menezes
pmc-12610117.description: This review provides a critical overview of MXenes, an innovative class of 2D transition metal carbides, nitrides, and carbonitrides, emphasizing their synthesis, properties, and application potential. We systematically examine synthesis methods, contrasting top-down approaches with emerging green alternatives and bottom-up techniques, evaluating each in terms of scalability, cost, and environmental impact.

pmc-12631682.title: Nanomedicine Solutions for Alzheimer’s Disease: A Critical Review of Therapeutic Nanoparticle Strategies
pmc-12631682.creator: Teboho E. Tutubala, Ayodeji O. Egunlusi, David Fisher, Admire Dube, Jacques Joubert
pmc-12631682.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a debilitating disorder marked by progressive memory and cognitive function loss. Current treatments, including acetylcholinesterase and N-methyl-d-aspartate receptor inhibitors, offer symptomatic relief but lack disease-modifying effects. The recent approval of aducanumab, an antibody clearing amyloid beta plaques, brings hope, though its therapeutic benefits are controversial.

pmc-12682778.title: Sensory-level electrical stimulation in children with cerebral palsy: a scoping review of current applications and outcomes
pmc-12682778.creator: Céline de Araujo, Alisa Gschaidmeier, Miriam von Gunten, Sebastian Grunt
pmc-12682778.description: IntroductionThis scoping review aims to map the existing literature on sensory-level electrical stimulation (ES) interventions for children with cerebral palsy (CP).MethodsMEDLINE, Embase and PEDro were searched. Among 504 screened articles, 18 studies were included. ES forms utilized included transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS), therapeutic electrical stimulation (TheES), threshold electrical stimulation (ThrES), Mesh-Glove Stimulation, and the Mollii suit.
